_comment: Rule-liveness ratchet baseline (tools/raman_saab/rule_liveness.py over the golden corpus). never_fired / yogas_never are the counts that MUST NOT INCREASE. Adding a rule no golden exercises, or breaking one so it stops firing, raises the count and fails test_rule_liveness. Fixing/covering rules lowers it -> re-baseline down. Re-based after the +25 NH Track-B charts (corpus 192->217): never_fired 88->84. 2026-08-23 (dead-rule sweep, conscious bump 82->84): the sweep encoded 14 previously-dead cited rules; twelve fire on >=1 golden, but H2.C.36 and H2.C.38 (the common/movable arms of the HTJAH-I:2492-2496 wealth-magnitude triplet, bphs-doctrine-reviewer VALIDATED verbatim, four-conjunct narrow) fire on none -- position-dependent rules with no structural impossibility (the fixed-sign sibling C.37 DOES fire once). Accepting two reviewer-validated-but-corpus-unexercised rules is the deliberate trade over leaving cited doctrine dead; the count remains a floor against SILENT additions. 2026-08-23 finale (H8-H3 passes, bump 84->85): six more dead rules encoded (H8.D.2, H10.C.56, H4.C.42, H5.C.3, H6.C.1, H6.C.19); five fire on goldens, H5.C.3 (Jupiter-as-strong-5th-lord aspected by the lagna lord, HTJAH-I:5185 rasi core) fires on none -- Scorpio/Leo-lagna gate x strength x aspect is narrow but chart-dependent and satisfiable. Same deliberate trade. 2026-08-23 (audit-ticket discharge, 739->741): H2.C.42 (1st-6th parivartana + maraka touch) and H2.C.43 (non-9/10-owning malefic in Lagna + maraka touch) encoded after the verbatim corpus check of HTJAH-I:2526-2528 discharged their gate; both fire on goldens (C.42 on 1, C.43 on 29 with the node-pair guard), never_fired stays 85. Same day (741->743): H11.C.6/C.7 re-encoded on the now-public dignity.compound_relation (the naisargika reading was proven unsatisfiable 2026-08-22; the compound reading is satisfiable and both VALIDATED on review); C.6 fires 12/211, C.7 17/211, never_fired stays 85. 2026-08-23 (verdict-merge + NH tail, re-base DOWN 60->58): the chart-block boundary was fixed to end at the next PRESENTATION rather than the next MENTION of a chart number -- Raman cross-references charts constantly, and 270 of Vol I's 364 presentations were being truncated before their Conclusion paragraph, which is where the verdict lives. Conclusions captured went 10->130 and 26 existing records gained a DRAFT house-verdict. The last 4 parseable Notable Horoscopes charts were ingested with them (NH is now exhausted for new charts), taking the corpus to 346 and dormancy to 58. Preceding entry: 2026-08-23 (HTJAH clean-edition batch 2, re-base DOWN 71->60): 60 further nativities mined from digitally-typeset Vol I + Vol II PDFs and deduped by birth moment; the golden chart corpus grew 282->342 and ELEVEN more dormant rules woke, plus two yogas (50->52, yogas_never 22->20). Cumulative across both batches today the corpus went 225->342 charts and dormancy 85->60 -- a 29% cut in dead doctrine surface, bought purely by giving the rules more of Raman's own nativities to fire on, with the verdict ratchet untouched at 261/294 throughout (the batches carry only DRAFT verdicts, which are never scored). Earlier entry for batch 1 follows. 2026-08-23 (HTJAH extraction batch, re-base DOWN 85->71): 57 worked charts were mined from HTJAH-I/II and verified by reproducing Raman's own printed Vimshottari balance (extract_htjah_goldens.py); the golden chart corpus grew 225->282 and FOURTEEN dormant rules woke up on the new nativities -- H11.C.22, H12.C.D5, H12.C.I5, H2.C.52, H2.C.63, H5.C.26, H5.C.29, H5.C.3, H6.C.16, H7.C.30, H8.D.1, H8.K.28, H9.A.6, H9.B.27. This is the empirical answer to 'why are rules dormant': for these fourteen it was CORPUS SIZE, not impossibility or a broken predicate -- including H5.C.3, which the 2026-08-23 sweep shipped as a deliberate reviewer-validated dormant rule and which now fires. Verdict ratchet untouched at 261/294 by construction (the batch carries no verdicts; only CONFIRMED verdicts score). One yoga also woke (49->50).
